knowledge.name: Packaged synthetic encounter records
knowledge.detail: Two fictional encounters contain source notes, observations, coded problems, medications, referral context, identifiers, and dates.

knowledge.name: Clinical review and privacy rules
knowledge.detail: Rules require minimum-necessary synthetic data, authorized-record comparison, clinician validation, and no live patient information.

knowledge.name: Operation skills and locked evidence anchors
knowledge.detail: Four skills define source-backed output contracts, safe routing, exact synthetic evidence, fallback behavior, and human review gates.

intelligence_processing.name: Source-grounded encounter extraction
intelligence_processing.detail: Extracts requested notes and observations without clinical inference, urgency determination, diagnosis, treatment, or clearance.

intelligence_processing.name: Medication source inventory
intelligence_processing.detail: Lists source-recorded medications in order for clinician or pharmacist reconciliation without interaction analysis or change advice.

intelligence_processing.name: Problem-list source extraction
intelligence_processing.detail: Returns exact source-coded problems while stating that no diagnosis was added, confirmed, removed, or changed.

intelligence_processing.name: Referral context extraction
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes recorded referral context while confirming that no referral or clinical order was placed, transmitted, scheduled, or changed.

intelligence_processing.name: Evidence-first request routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps clinician language to one of four bounded operations and returns only the matching synthetic record evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the validated Draft pilot with four skills, two synthetic knowledge files, integrated authentication, and no publication approval.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file RAPP tool through local chat and API routes with deterministic, read-only synthetic operation routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Clinician and pharmacist review experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Primary care, surgery, anesthesia, and pharmacy reviewers receive compact drafts that require comparison with the authorized record.

management_reporting.name: Encounter summary draft
management_reporting.detail: Presents encounter date, source note, observations, identifier, and states that clinical interpretation was not performed.

management_reporting.name: Medication reconciliation inventory
management_reporting.detail: Reports source-recorded medication names, doses, and frequency while reserving reconciliation, interactions, and changes for reviewers.

management_reporting.name: Problem-list evidence extract
management_reporting.detail: Lists source-coded problems in source order and documents that the agent did not add, confirm, remove, or change a diagnosis.

management_reporting.name: Referral context review
management_reporting.detail: Shows the recorded referral draft and status while confirming no referral placement, scheduling, transmission, or record change occurred.

tools.name: ClinicalNotesSummarizerAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements four deterministic read-only operations over bundled fictional encounter records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the cli-copilot Draft package, four operation skills, two synthetic knowledge files, and integrated authentication.

tools.name: Host-selected foundation model
tools.detail: Routes natural-language intent and composes user-facing drafts from deterministic tool or packaged skill evidence.

tools.name: Power Platform CLI
tools.detail: Initializes, pulls, and pushes the Copilot Studio source package; publication remains a separate human-approved step.

tools.name: Governed healthcare record interface
tools.detail: Future read-only Dynamics 365 or approved healthcare data seam; the current package has no live connection or write permission.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only privacy boundary
supporting_features.detail: Never requests, retains, infers, or exposes live patient information and keeps all packaged identities and clinical facts fictional.

supporting_features.name: Minimum-necessary data handling
supporting_features.detail: Selects only the requested synthetic identifier and matching fields instead of exposing unrelated encounter evidence.

supporting_features.name: Mandatory clinician validation gate
supporting_features.detail: Every substantive draft must be compared with the authorized record and verified by a qualified clinical or operational reviewer.

supporting_features.name: No diagnosis or treatment boundary
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits diagnosis confirmation, treatment advice, prognosis, urgency decisions, medical necessity, and clinical clearance.

supporting_features.name: No order entry or workflow writes
supporting_features.detail: Prevents placing or changing orders, referrals, appointments, medications, messages, authorizations, tasks, or records.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed identifier handling
supporting_features.detail: Unknown encounter identifiers return no match and never trigger record substitution, browsing, or invented clinical evidence.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Four isolated Brainstem cases and four Copilot Studio previews passed; the pilot remains Draft and unpublished.
